'''Bailey''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Republic soldier]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Along with [[Ferron]] and [[Imani]], he was working on restoring the electrical grid in the [[Tularan Marsh]], but kept hitting the power surges, so they asked a passerby to get to the [[Power generator/Legends|generators]] and set them into emergency mode.{{Char-stub}}
